items.name: Bloom Filter Coffee
items.description: Ethical filter coffee, served per person.

items.name: Specialty Tea & Coffee
items.description: Specialty teas and coffee, served per person.

items.name: Belu Water Bottle
items.description: 750ml still or sparkling mineral water. All profits go to WaterAid.

items.name: A Selection of Canned Drinks
items.description: Coke, Diet Coke, Coke Zero, Sprite and Fanta Orange.

items.name: Fresh Squeezed & Pressed Juice
items.description: 250ml bottle. Orange, seasonal apple, carrot pear & ginger, or seasonal blood orange.

items.name: Fresh Squeezed & Pressed Juice
items.description: 1L bottle. Orange, seasonal apple, carrot pear & ginger, or seasonal blood orange.

items.name: Fresh Pressed Ginger, Turmeric & Lemon Shot
Freshly Made Smoothie
items.description: 1L bottle. Green Glow, Berry Boost or Island Breeze.

items.name: Freshly Baked Cookie Box
items.description: 24 freshly baked mixed cookies including milk chocolate, double chocolate, white chocolate, chocolate chip and Carnivals Smarties cookies.

items.name: Tray Bake Box
items.description: Medium box contains 24 pieces and can be cut into 48 smaller bites. Example flavours include caramel Rolo brownie, caramelised biscuit brownie, raspberry & white chocolate blondies, and lemon & white chocolate blondies.

items.name: Exotic Fruit Box
items.description: Watermelon, cantaloupe melon, honey dew melon, pineapple, kiwi, passion fruit and strawberries.

items.name: Mini Pastries
items.description: A selection of two mini Danish and bite-size chocolate muffins per person, garnished with strawberries and icing sugar.

items.name: Freshly Baked Large Pastries
items.description: Four plain croissants, four raspberry croissants and four almond croissants.

items.name: Filled Savoury Croissant
items.description: Four Swiss cheese, Wiltshire ham & vine tomato; four free-range egg mayonnaise, sun blush tomato & roquette; four smoked Chalk Stream trout, cream cheese & dill.

items.name: Vegan Savoury Croissant
items.description: Four smashed avocado & sun blushed tomatoes; four smoked Applewood cheese, green tomato chutney & roquette; four roast portobello mushroom, baby spinach & vegan feta.

items.name: Bagel Box
items.description: 12 bagels cut in half. Choose smoked trout, crispy bacon & egg mayonnaise, roasted red pepper with smashed avocado, or mixed.

options.label: Chapel Swan smoked trout, soft cream cheese & dill
Crispy bacon & free range egg mayonnaise
Roasted red pepper, smashed avocado & baby spinach

items.name: Breakfast Pots
items.description: Weekly changing menu. Options include fruit salad, Greek yoghurt, vegan yoghurt, free range boiled egg & baby spinach, smashed avocado with smoked salmon and egg, or overnight oats.

options.label: Free range boiled egg & baby spinach
Smashed avocado, smoked salmon & free range boiled egg

items.name: Healthy Plant Power Breakfast
items.description: Example menu includes seasonal poached fruit with coconut chia, vegan banana bread, sourdough crostini with smashed avocado, flapjack and fresh ginger shot.

items.name: Deli Style Sandwich Lunch
items.description: Three pieces per person. Meat, fish and vegetarian fillings on artisan breads such as ciabatta, focaccia, baguettes and wraps, served with hand cooked vegetable crisps.

items.name: Individual Boxed Lunch
items.description: Deli style sandwich, pasta salad, vegetable crisps, sausage roll and mini traybake. Vegan and gluten-free available on request.

items.name: Salad & Protein Lunch Platter
items.description: Three composite salads plus one meat protein, one fish protein and one veggie or vegan protein.

items.name: Freshly Wrapped Rice Paper Rolls
items.description: 12 wraps per platter, each platter contains one flavour with dipping sauce.

items.name: Grazing Box - Charcuterie
items.description: Cobble Lane cured British charcuterie, Gordal olives, sun blush tomatoes, baby gherkins, stuffed cherrybell peppers, artisan breads, olive oil and balsamic.

items.name: Cheese Box
items.description: British county cheeses including Wookey Hole Cheddar, Colston Bassett Stilton, Hampshire Tunworth and Cornish Yarg in nettles with Stokes beer chutney and artisan biscuits.

items.name: Picnic Box
items.description: Freshly baked sausage rolls, Scotch eggs, pork pies, chicken skewers and tomato quiche with Stokes beer chutney and red onion marmalade.

items.name: Vegan Box
items.description: Vegan mezze with rainbow radish, cucumber and carrot shards, edamame beans, sweet potato falafel, olives, little gem spears, cherry tomatoes, pickles, toasted pita and three hummus flavours.

items.name: Salad Boxes
items.description: Mediterranean, grilled chicken Caesar, hot smoked salmon Nicoise, or weekly salad box on request.

items.name: Weekly Salad Box
items.description: Weekly salad boxes available. Menu on request.

items.name: Deluxe Sushi Box
items.description: 84 pieces. Mixed selection of nigiri, maki and uramaki served with pickled ginger, wasabi and soy.

items.name: Vegan Sushi Box
items.description: 72 pieces. Mixed plant based selection of nigiri, maki and uramaki served with pickled ginger, wasabi and soy.

items.name: Fika Glow Bowl
items.description: Individual salad bowl. Choose avocado Mex, sweet potato & quinoa, Mediterranean veg, or Asian prawn & edamame.

items.name: Picnic Grazing Table
items.description: British charcuterie, sausage rolls, olives, breads, crudites, falafel, hummus, British county cheese board, artisan biscuits and fresh cut fruit.

items.name: Grazing Sweet Table
items.description: Lemon mousse, tiramisu coffee shots, mini pavlova, salted caramel canelles, mini passion fruit meringue pies and macaroon tower.

items.name: Grazing Cups
items.description: Individual cups with charcuterie, cheese with olives and crisp breads, falafel and dried fruit, and pretzels.

items.name: Afternoon Tea
items.description: Three bridge rolls from six fillings, colourful macaroon, salted caramel canelles, lemon mousse, Black Forest gateau, passion fruit meringue, and teas with milk and cream.

items.name: Finger Food
items.description: Minimum recommended four pieces per person. Choose meat, fish, vegetarian, vegan and dessert options from the brochure selection.

items.name: Hot Fork Buffet - Gold Package
items.description: Meat, fish, vegan, two sides, four salads and one dessert. Menu on request.

items.name: Hot Fork Buffet - Silver Package
items.description: Meat, vegan, two sides and four salads. Menu on request.

items.name: Bowl Food
items.description: Three bowls per person. Example menu includes chorizo jambalaya, plant based cumin lamb meatball tagine and hot smoked salmon Caesar salad.

items.name: Fika Canapes
items.description: Six items per person. Hot canapes can only be offered on sites with an oven or a hire charge.

items.name: Fika Corporate Dining
items.description: Bespoke seated dining menus served with homemade focaccia and flavoured butters. One menu per booking.

items.name: Example Christmas Themed Menu
items.description: Roast turkey with trimmings, butternut squash wellington, roast potatoes, honey glazed roots, Brussels sprouts, chocolate orange cheesecake, mince pies and brandy cream.

items.name: Bespoke Event Menu
items.description: For Thanksgiving, Christmas, Valentine's Day or other themed events. The team will create a tailored proposal.
